messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to losartan.
These signs include hives, difficulty breathing, and swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Losartan may cause serious side effects.
Call your doctor at once if you have:
a light-headed feeling, like you might pass out;
high blood potassium - nausea, weakness, tingly feeling, chest pain, irregular heartbeats, loss of movement; or
kidney problems - swelling, urinating less, feeling tired or short of breath.
Common losartan side effects may include:
dizziness, tiredness;
low blood pressure;
low blood sugar;
diarrhea;
back pain; or
cold symptoms such as stuffy nose, sneezing, sore throat.
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["losartan", "has reporting instruction", "report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088"]

The relation 'has reporting instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires the reporting action specified by the object entity to be followed by the patient.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires prescriptions to be reported to': The subject entity mandates that prescriptions for the drug be reported to the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
D. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
E. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
